component.name: FSR 1 Upscale Filter
component.summary: Video filter that upscales sources with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0

description.p: Adds a video filter named "FSR 1 Upscale" to OBS Studio. It upscales a source, for example a webcam or a low-resolution capture card, to a higher resolution using the FSR 1 algorithm (edge-adaptive upsampling followed by contrast-adaptive sharpening), with an optional noise-aware sharpening mode.
